item.title: Larger Than Life: The Legacy Of Solair, 2017-2025
item.description: Sometimes the world needs a reminder that behind the polished, poised animals we see in the show ring, horses all have a story to tell that is written after the arena lights go dark. More than just a collector of golden globes and grand champion neck sashes, legendary AQHA halter gelding Solair’s story is one of forging friendships, dedicated teamwork, shared dreams, and boundless love.
